description:
On-chain sentiment read for a token derived from smart-money wallet net flows. Returns a sentiment label (bullish, bearish or neutral) and net USD flow direction. Use it when the user asks what smart-money sentiment is for an asset, or wants a quick bullish or bearish read from on-chain flow data. For X or Twitter social sentiment use get_social_sentiment instead.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chain.description: Chain name or slug, e.g. ethereum or base.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_smart_money_sentiment
